mapper.sql: orders.id AS order_id, orders.order_no, orders.user_id, orders.show_id, shows.movie_id, shows.cinema_id, shows.start_time AS show_start_time, orders.ticket_count, orders.unit_price, orders.total_amount, orders.status, orders.expire_time, orders.paid_time, orders.cancelled_time, orders.refunded_time, orders.version, orders.create_time AS created_at, orders.update_time AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket_order orders INNER JOIN movie_show shows ON shows.id = orders.show_id WHERE orders.order_no = #{orderNo}
